Curator’s walkthrough of the exhibition “Beads – From a Necklace”, presenting select beads from the museum collection. The walkthrough offers a look into the varied forms and cultural contexts of beads across time.
The exhibition is on view till 31 March at the Patna Museum, Buddha Marg, Patna. For more information on our events and exhibitions, please visit our website biharmuseum.org.
